title: a lock held by someone else that never frees fails the launch with exit 3, writes no event, closes the terminal it opened and leaves no launch folder
source: cli/jitso/log.test.ts: 'gives up with a clear error when a fresh lock never frees'
intended: owner decision 2026-11-15: a failed launch leaves no launch folder
intent: INTENDED behavior (owner decision 2026-11-15, defect N-2). A launch that fails before its registry line leaves no launch folder behind: the implementation removes .jitso/launches/<id>/ when the registry lock never frees. The exit code, the stderr text, the empty registry and the orca calls (the terminal it opened is closed) are unchanged.
